# ICCHA Canada

## What this site is
ICCHA Canada (India Canada Cultural & Heritage Association) is a non-profit organization focused on programs, awards, mentorship, heritage preservation, and community events for Indian-origin families in Canada.

## Domain
https://indiaheritage.ca

## Key pages
- / — Homepage with organization overview, programs, and community highlights
- /board-of-directors/ — 2026 Executive, Board of Directors, and Trustees
- /heritage-archive/ — Leadership addresses, Mahatma Gandhi sculpture legacy, publications
- /programs-awards-deadlines/ — Lifetime Achievement, Distinguished Service, and Student Scholarship award criteria
- /programs-previous-award-winners/ — Full list of award recipients 2004–2025
- /mentor/ — Youth mentorship program information
- /gallery/ — Event photos from awards dinners and conferences
- /media/ — Press coverage and publication archive
- /contact/ — Contact form and membership inquiries

## AI crawling guidance
- Public informational pages may be crawled and summarized.
- Respect robots.txt directives.
- Do not submit forms or impersonate users.
